description: Create Phase 100 (data-collection) and Phase 200 (feasibility-analysis) skills that convert the existing framework README prompts into self-contained, invocable Kiro skills. Each skill contains the full workflow logic previously found in the README copy-paste prompts, references the framework files using workspace-root-relative paths, and guides the user to the next skill in the sequence.
steps: Create .kiro/skills/data-collection/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter (name: data-collection, description about Phase 100 portfolio-level application and database discovery). The workflow should cover: determining pre-population approach (customer fills vs pre-populate from docs vs pre-populate from source code), invoking the excel-analysis skill for spreadsheet operations, executing the appropriate extraction logic, reviewing gaps, and guiding user to send for validation then proceed to Phase 200 feasibility-analysis skill.

Create .kiro/skills/feasibility-analysis/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter (name: feasibility-analysis, description about Phase 200 modernization feasibility scoring and wave planning). The workflow should cover: reading the completed inventory, referencing framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/feasibility-analysis.md for analysis rules, referencing framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/210-Tool-Feasibility/aws-tools-analysis.md for AWS tool checks, running all four analysis steps (Windows workload classification, AWS Transform eligibility, complexity scoring, prioritization matrix), optionally running ATX Comprehensive Codebase Analysis accelerator, saving output, and guiding user to proceed to Phase 300.
acceptance_criteria: .kiro/skills/data-collection/SKILL.md exists with valid YAML frontmatter (name + description) and step-by-step workflow
.kiro/skills/feasibility-analysis/SKILL.md exists with valid YAML frontmatter (name + description) and step-by-step workflow
data-collection skill contains all the extraction logic from framework/100-Data-Collection/README.md (Option A and Option B approaches, pre-populate from documents, pre-populate from source code)
data-collection skill references the excel-analysis skill by name for spreadsheet operations
data-collection skill references framework/100-Data-Collection/100-App-Inventory.xlsx using workspace-root-relative path

feasibility-analysis skill references framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/feasibility-analysis.md and framework/200-Mod-Feasibility/210-Tool-Feasibility/aws-tools-analysis.md using workspace-root-relative paths
feasibility-analysis skill includes ATX Comprehensive Codebase Analysis accelerator workflow
Both skills mention which downstream skill to invoke next
Skills are self-contained with all logic/instructions previously in the README prompts
verification: Confirm .kiro/skills/data-collection/SKILL.md exists and has valid YAML frontmatter with --- delimiters
Confirm .kiro/skills/feasibility-analysis/SKILL.md exists and has valid YAML frontmatter with --- delimiters
